text:
### Risk Re-Assessment  
**Recalculate Customer Risk Based on New Address:**  
Previous Risk: [e.g., Low]
New Risk: [e.g., Medium if moved abroad]  
**If Risk Category Changed Upward:**
- Flag for Compliance review
- May trigger enhanced due diligence
- Ongoing monitoring may increase
- Customer may be notified of account restrictions
name: Chunk 25/52

raw_entities.name: Risk Re-Assessment Process
raw_entities.description: An operational procedure to recalculate customer risk classification based on new address information. The process compares previous and new risk categories, and if risk increases, triggers compliance review, enhanced due diligence, and potential account restrictions.
context: Recalculate Customer Risk Based on New Address
If Risk Category Changed Upward: Flag for Compliance review
May trigger enhanced due diligence
Ongoing monitoring may increase

raw_entities.name: Risk Category Recalculation
raw_entities.description: The step in which customer risk is recalculated based on new address information, comparing the previous risk level against the new risk level determined by the address change.
context: Recalculate Customer Risk Based on New Address
Previous Risk: [e.g., Low]
New Risk: [e.g., Medium if moved abroad]

raw_entities.name: Compliance Review Flagging
raw_entities.description: The step triggered when risk category increases upward, flagging the case for formal compliance review to determine appropriate response actions.
context: If Risk Category Changed Upward: Flag for Compliance review

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Trigger
raw_entities.description: A conditional step that may be activated when risk category increases, requiring enhanced due diligence procedures to be applied to the customer account.
context: May trigger enhanced due diligence

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Monitoring Escalation
raw_entities.description: A step in which the level of ongoing transaction and activity monitoring on the customer account is increased in response to upward risk category change.
context: Ongoing monitoring may increase

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification of Account Restrictions
raw_entities.description: A conditional step in which the customer may be notified of account restrictions or limitations imposed as a result of the upward risk category change.
context: Customer may be notified of account restrictions

raw_entities.name: Risk Category Change Decision
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that determines whether the recalculated risk category has moved upward from the previous risk level. If yes, compliance review and enhanced controls are triggered; if no, the process concludes.
context: If Risk Category Changed Upward
Previous Risk: [e.g., Low]
New Risk: [e.g., Medium if moved abroad]

raw_entities.name: Address Change
raw_entities.description: A customer address change that triggers the risk re-assessment process. The new address is the basis for recalculating customer risk classification, particularly when the customer has moved abroad.
context: Recalculate Customer Risk Based on New Address
New Risk: [e.g., Medium if moved abroad]

raw_entities.name: Risk Category Upward Movement Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance checkpoint that verifies whether a customer's risk category has increased following address change. If the gate is triggered (risk moved upward), compliance review, enhanced due diligence, and monitoring escalation are mandated.
context: If Risk Category Changed Upward: Flag for Compliance review
May trigger enhanced due diligence
Ongoing monitoring may increase

raw_entities.name: Compliance Review Approver
raw_entities.description: The compliance function responsible for reviewing flagged cases when customer risk category increases, determining whether enhanced due diligence and account restrictions are warranted.
context: Flag for Compliance review

properties.purpose: Recalculate customer risk classification based on new address and trigger appropriate compliance actions
properties.scope: All customers with address changes that may impact risk profile
properties.outcome_success: Risk category accurately recalculated and appropriate compliance measures applied
properties.outcome_failure: Risk misclassification leading to inadequate monitoring or unnecessary restrictions

properties.input: Customer address change, previous risk classification

properties.output: Compliance review flag if upward movement detected
Enhanced due diligence initiation if applicable

properties.decision_question: Has the customer's risk category moved upward?
properties.criteria: Comparison of previous risk classification with new risk classification based on address change
properties.path_yes: Proceed to Compliance Review Flagging, Enhanced Due Diligence Trigger, Ongoing Monitoring Escalation, and Customer Notification
properties.path_no: Process complete; maintain current monitoring level

properties.collection_steps: Customer provides new address during account update
properties.verification_steps: Address verified and used as input to risk recalculation
properties.recording_system: Customer profile and risk assessment system

properties.name: Risk Category Upward Movement Compliance Gate

properties.checkpoint_name: Risk Category Upward Movement Compliance Gate
properties.regulatory_basis: AML/CFT ongoing customer due diligence requirements
properties.evidence_required: Risk recalculation documentation, address change record
properties.timing: Upon detection of upward risk category movement
properties.failure_consequence: Inadequate compliance response to elevated risk; potential regulatory breach

properties.authority_level: Can approve compliance review flags, trigger enhanced due diligence, escalate monitoring, and authorize customer notifications

Ongoing Monitoring Escalation is followed by Customer Notification of Account Restrictions.
